t: Forge Steel 1/4" drive socket and bit set is a versatile tool kit for various fastening applications. The 53-piece set offers a comprehensive range of metric and imperial screwdriver bits and sockets, ideal for electricians, mechanics, and general workshop tasks. Features a robust 72-tooth mini ratchet handle with a flip reverse switch for quick direction changes, and a secure ball socket lock. The shatterproof handle ensures durability on site and in the workshop. All components are housed in a compact, fold-up storage case for organised transport and easy access, making it a reliable solution for professional use. The nickel-plated, abrasion-resistant finish provides lasting protection.
